## Distributor of Prestige Fragrances and Cosmetics

For over 25 years, we've proudly served as the leading wholesale distributor in the USA,
specializing in top-tier fragrances, skin care, cosmetics, and gift sets. We handpick and supply
products from the most esteemed manufacturers, ensuring you receive only the finest selections. With
our deep-rooted reputation for reliability and excellence, you can always count on us to elevate
your beauty and fragrance offerings.

[Contact Us][10]

# Reasons to Buy from MB Fragrances

The MB Promise: Six Reasons Why We Stand Out

**Extensive Range of Products:** Dive into our diverse selection of perfumes, cosmetics, and
skincare products, curated to suit every taste and preference.
**Competitive Wholesale Pricing: **With us, you'll always get the best value. Our strong ties with
top manufacturers and bulk purchasing power allow us to provide products at unbeatable wholesale
prices.
**Fast & Reliable Shipping: **Our state-of-the-art logistics ensures that your orders are processed
swiftly and delivered on time. Whether it's a bulk order or a single item, we prioritize getting it
to you promptly.
**Tailored Solutions for Retailers: **Whether you're a small boutique or a large retailer, we can
cater to your specific needs. Our team is adept at customizing orders to match your inventory
demands.
**Exclusive Deals & Offers:** Loyal customers enjoy a plethora of exclusive deals, offers, and
discounts. Stay with us and discover unbeatable savings!
**Automated Documentation Process:** Navigating international trade can be complex, but with us,
it's seamless. Our advanced system automates the generation of essential documents, from export
invoices to packing slips and bills of lading. This ensures accurate, timely, and hassle-free
transactions, allowing you to focus on what you do best.
[Contact Us][11]

# Some of the Coveted Brands We Carry

With access to thousands of fragrance brands, our selection distinctively highlights the world's
most esteemed names. From niche to mainstream, our extensive inventory ensures we can meet all your
business needs.

## Our Impact By The Numbers

Measurable Excellence, Tangible Impact

Dive into the metrics that define our presence in the wholesale landscape of perfumes, cosmetics,
and skincare. We pride ourselves on our expansive reach, operational efficiency, and unwavering
commitment to our clientele.

1K+ SkusA Diverse Portfolio: Boasting an extensive selection spanning numerous renowned brands and
unique products.

1200+Trusted by Retailers: Serving a vast network of retail partners and marking our footprint
across multiple countries.

98.9%Customer satisfaction: With a customer satisfaction rate of 98.9%, our dedication to serving
our clients needs is evident. Our continuous efforts to provide top-tier products, responsive
service, and consistent deliveries have earned us the trust and loyalty of businesses nationwide.

25+ YearsA Legacy of Excellence: Proudly serving the wholesale fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare
industry for over 25 years, our journey reflects a commitment to quality and an enduring passion for
bringing the best to our clients. This longevity is not just a testament to our resilience but also
to the trust our customers place in us.

## NOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE

Reconnaitre l’importance de la responsabilité, du vivant, et de la durabilité, nous pousse à nous
transformer. Agir vite et bien. Pour accompagner nos clients acteurs du changement, Robertet façonne
le Naturel du futur.

[Futuring Naturals][61]

## ROBERTET X ASSOULINE

À l’occasion de son 175ᵉ anniversaire, Robertet dévoile un ouvrage d’exception édité par Assouline,
maison reconnue pour ses livres dédiés à l’art, au luxe et au patrimoine.

Disponible sur le site d’Assouline, ce livre retrace l’histoire singulière de Robertet, depuis ses
origines à Grasse jusqu’à son rayonnement international. À travers des archives inédites, des
témoignages et des images exclusives, il met en lumière l’héritage, le savoir-faire et la passion du
naturel qui animent le Groupe depuis 1850.

Plus qu’un livre anniversaire, cet ouvrage incarne l’ADN de Robertet : l’excellence, la créativité
et un engagement constant en faveur d’une innovation responsable, tournée vers l’avenir.

Véritable objet de collection, cette édition célèbre la transmission d’un savoir-faire unique et
rend hommage aux femmes et aux hommes qui font vivre la Maison depuis cinq générations.

[Découvrir][62]

## ROBERTET INVESTIT DANS AETHERA BIOTECH

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer l’investissement stratégique de Robertet dans Aethera Biotech, pionnier
européen des ingrédients cosmétiques actifs.

Cette étape marque notre entrée dans le domaine des biotechnologies végétales et renforce notre
stratégie « Augmented Naturality ». En combinant la technologie brevetée CROP® d’Aethera Biotech
avec l’expertise mondiale et la portée commerciale de Robertet Group, nous accélérerons l’innovation
dans les actifs cosmétiques et soutiendrons la croissance à long terme de notre division Health &
Beauty.

Une nouvelle étape pour réunir la nature et la science de pointe.

[Interview : Olivier Maubert][63]

## ECOVADIS : STATUT PLATINIUM

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que Robertet renforce son score EcoVadis.

Après avoir obtenu l’an dernier la médaille Platine avec un score de 83/100, Robertet a encore
progressé cette année en atteignant 88/100.

Cette distinction, attribuée aux entreprises figurant dans le Top 1 % mondial, reconnaît la qualité
et la solidité du système de management de la durabilité de notre Groupe. L’évaluation EcoVadis
repose sur quatre domaines clés : l’Environnement, le Social & Droits Humains, l’Éthique et les
Achats Responsables.

Cette progression illustre la détermination de Robertet à aller toujours plus loin dans l’alliance
entre performance et responsabilité.

Nous remercions l’ensemble de nos équipes pour leur engagement collectif et quotidien, et plus
particulièrement notre Directrice RSE, pour son dévouement constant dans cette réussite.

## NOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE

Reconnaitre l’importance de la responsabilité, du vivant, et de la durabilité, nous pousse à nous
transformer. Agir vite et bien. Pour accompagner nos clients acteurs du changement, Robertet façonne
le Naturel du futur.

[Futuring Naturals][61]

## ROBERTET X ASSOULINE

À l’occasion de son 175ᵉ anniversaire, Robertet dévoile un ouvrage d’exception édité par Assouline,
maison reconnue pour ses livres dédiés à l’art, au luxe et au patrimoine.

Disponible sur le site d’Assouline, ce livre retrace l’histoire singulière de Robertet, depuis ses
origines à Grasse jusqu’à son rayonnement international. À travers des archives inédites, des
témoignages et des images exclusives, il met en lumière l’héritage, le savoir-faire et la passion du
naturel qui animent le Groupe depuis 1850.

Plus qu’un livre anniversaire, cet ouvrage incarne l’ADN de Robertet : l’excellence, la créativité
et un engagement constant en faveur d’une innovation responsable, tournée vers l’avenir.

Véritable objet de collection, cette édition célèbre la transmission d’un savoir-faire unique et
rend hommage aux femmes et aux hommes qui font vivre la Maison depuis cinq générations.

[Découvrir][62]

## ROBERTET INVESTIT DANS AETHERA BIOTECH

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer l’investissement stratégique de Robertet dans Aethera Biotech, pionnier
européen des ingrédients cosmétiques actifs.

Cette étape marque notre entrée dans le domaine des biotechnologies végétales et renforce notre
stratégie « Augmented Naturality ». En combinant la technologie brevetée CROP® d’Aethera Biotech
avec l’expertise mondiale et la portée commerciale de Robertet Group, nous accélérerons l’innovation
dans les actifs cosmétiques et soutiendrons la croissance à long terme de notre division Health &
Beauty.

Une nouvelle étape pour réunir la nature et la science de pointe.

[Interview : Olivier Maubert][63]

## ECOVADIS : STATUT PLATINIUM

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que Robertet renforce son score EcoVadis.

Après avoir obtenu l’an dernier la médaille Platine avec un score de 83/100, Robertet a encore
progressé cette année en atteignant 88/100.

Cette distinction, attribuée aux entreprises figurant dans le Top 1 % mondial, reconnaît la qualité
et la solidité du système de management de la durabilité de notre Groupe. L’évaluation EcoVadis
repose sur quatre domaines clés : l’Environnement, le Social & Droits Humains, l’Éthique et les
Achats Responsables.

Cette progression illustre la détermination de Robertet à aller toujours plus loin dans l’alliance
entre performance et responsabilité.

Nous remercions l’ensemble de nos équipes pour leur engagement collectif et quotidien, et plus
particulièrement notre Directrice RSE, pour son dévouement constant dans cette réussite.

## INAUGURATION – CENTRE CREATIF AU BRESIL

Le Brésil occupe une place stratégique dans le développement de Robertet et constitue l’un des plus
grands marchés mondiaux des parfums et des arômes.

L’inauguration de notre Creative Center, l’un des plus importants du Groupe, marque une nouvelle
étape de notre développement en Amérique latine.

Pensé comme un véritable lieu d’innovation et de co-création, il nous permet de renforcer notre
proximité avec nos clients et d’accompagner le développement de solutions en parfumerie, arômes et
ingrédients naturels, au plus près des besoins du marché local.

## RÉSULTATS ANNUELS 2025.

En 2025, Robertet a enregistré une nouvelle année de croissance avec un chiffre d’affaires de 843,9
M€, en progression organique de 7,6 %, et un EBITDA de 174 M€, représentant une marge de 20,6 %.

Malgré un contexte économique mondial incertain, ces résultats reflètent la solidité du modèle du
Groupe, porté par son expertise du naturel, son agilité et sa dynamique d’innovation.

Ils confirment également la pertinence de la stratégie de développement de Robertet et renforcent sa
confiance dans ses ambitions à l’horizon 2030.

[Rapport financier annuel][64]

## CLEAN R SCENT : Nouvelle génération d’absolues

CleanRscent est la nouvelle gamme d’absolues éco-conçues de Robertet, basée sur une technologie
brevetée, offrant une réponse immédiate aux demandes des clients et du marché pour une parfumerie
plus responsable. Ouvrant une voie d’avenir pour les absolues, ingrédients emblématiques de la
parfumerie, cleanRscent offre une haute performance olfactive avec un profil authentique « True to
Nature » et une signature unique pour des parfums éco-conçus, 100% sans résidus d’hexane.

La vision d’entreprise de Robertet s’inscrit dans le long terme et tisse des liens durables. Elle
offre des repères stables et s’appuie sur des valeurs responsables.

# Sensient Technologies

Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors,
and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain
capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve
the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic, and personal care industries.

# Structured Industrial Access to Latin America for Global Manufacturers

Latin America is not a market to explore. It is a region that requires structure, qualified
representation, and a defined operational pathway. ConectNext functions as a strategic bridge
enabling industrial manufacturers and solution providers to establish a credible and effective
presence across the region.

ConectNext is not a traditional directory. It is an integrated expansion platform that combines
regional visibility, governed representation, and on-the-ground execution within a unified
operational ecosystem. We work with international companies seeking to enter and scale in Latin
America, enabling structured access to relevant decision-makers, distributors, industrial buyers,
and institutional counterparts across more than 23 strategic sectors, including Industrial
Machinery, AgriTech, Pharma, Energy, Logistics, and Advanced Materials.

Latin America encompasses a market of more than 670 million people and a combined GDP exceeding USD
6.4 trillion, representing one of the world’s most dynamic growth environments. However, successful
market entry requires far more than commercial intent. It demands local presence, regulatory
clarity, cultural alignment, and trusted operational frameworks.

Through ConectNext, organizations gain structured access to the region, supported by qualified
representation, sector-specific intelligence, and a vetted operational network. This approach
ensures that expansion into Latin America is strategic, scalable, and aligned with real commercial
opportunity — not speculation.

The platform’s full structural definition is outlined in [What Is ConectNext][19].

## Why ConectNext Is the Strategic Choice for Expansion into Latin America

ConectNext is built specifically for manufacturers, industrial technology providers, and B2B
solution firms that require a structured and reliable entry into Latin America. Expanding into the
region is not simply a commercial initiative — it is an operational decision that demands market
clarity, controlled risk, and local presence. ConectNext centralizes these capabilities within a
single, integrated expansion hub.

Our platform aligns market access, regional visibility, commercial representation, and operational
execution under one coordinated framework. This enables companies to evaluate, enter, and expand in
Latin America without opening a local office, committing to high upfront investment, or navigating
fragmented networks independently.

The ConectNext model bridges global strategy with local implementation. International intent is
translated into on-the-ground execution through governed structures. Whether the objective is to
validate demand, position a brand, establish distribution pathways, or develop long-term commercial
presence, ConectNext operates as a strategic business extension in [Colombia and across Latin
America.][20]

From sector intelligence and competitive benchmarking to trade fair participation, commercial
representation, negotiation support, and structured engagement aligned with defined mandates, we
ensure that expansion initiatives remain coordinated, professional, and grounded in real commercial
opportunity.

B2B Expansion Platform: [Scope And Participation Model][21] 

**ConectNext. We provide structure**

## Structured Industrial Visibility

ConectNext provides a governed visibility framework within defined industrial sectors. Exposure is
structured by industry relevance, operational scope, and decision context, ensuring that visibility
is contextual, deliberate, and aligned with how industrial decisions are actually made.

## Controlled Market Presence

Market presence is established through structured positioning, representation frameworks, and
defined responsibility boundaries. Engagement occurs under clear governance rules, preserving
professional distance, accountability, and continuity without requiring premature local deployment
or uncontrolled intermediaries.

## Decision-Grade Market Intelligence

ConectNext delivers sector-specific analysis, structural demand signals, and competitive context
designed to support informed decision-making. Intelligence is framed to reduce uncertainty, clarify
exposure, and support strategic judgment — not to replace it with assumptions or forecasts.

To learn how we build and validate our analytical outputs, review the* [ConectNext Research
Framework.][22]*

July 14, 2026

Strong brands know exactly who they serve best. For CoverGirl, that means reconnecting with a
generation that has been central to the brand's story for decades. Gen X accounts for roughly
one-third of beauty spending and is projected to remain the world's highest-spending generation
across consumer categories through at least 2033 — a consumer group with real purchasing power and a
clear appreciation for quality, accessibility, and value. Gordon von Bretten, President of Consumer
Beauty, put it plainly in Bloomberg Businessweek: "We're going to be intentional about serving that
consumer, rather than trying to be everything to everyone." That intentionality shows up in the work
— from campaigns featuring models aged 45 to 55 to sub-$10 innovation that keeps accessibility at
the core. Serving Gen X with greater focus, while remaining a brand for all generations, is what
powers CoverGirl's next chapter of growth. Read the full story in Bloomberg Businessweek:

FEATURED BRANDS
* ## Kajal Perfumes Paris
  
  **Kajal Perfumes Paris **is a French niche fragrance house that draws inspiration from the Arabic
  word khajal – which means** being humble, modest and viewing others with dignity and respect**.
* ## Laboratorio Olfattivo
  
  A high-end perfumery project of artistic perfumery working with *Maîtres Parfumeurs* who create
  freely, without any limitations on their imagination. Noses include **Jean-Claude Elena**,
  **Cecile Zarokian** and **Dominic Ropion**.
* ## Filippo Sorcinelli
  
  **Filippo Sorcinelli **is a lifestyle brand, the result of a collaboration between the **arts**. A
  brand that is synonymous with **niche fragrances** and **daring concepts**.
* ## Nobile 1942
  
  **Nobile 1942 **carries on a rich family tradition of perfumery. Each bottle is **hand-crafted
  **and each scent is specially selected from the work of the **best perfumers** across the world.
* ## Scentologia
  
  **Scentologia **is a luxury fragrance brand founded in **Paris **and built on the idea that
  perfumery is a unique intersection of **art and science**, where the laboratory meets the canvas.

[ SEE ALL BRANDS ][23]

## OUR SERVICES

[Kajal Perfumes Display]

#### Brand Distribution & Activation

Our perfume distribution and activation services bring niche, artisanal and luxury fragrances to
discerning North American retailers. With a curated portfolio of exclusive perfume houses, we ensure
that each scent reaches high-end clients and boutiques with precision and care. Our industry
knowledge and relationships allow us to provide tailored solutions for every brand’s unique
distribution, marketing and educational needs.

[Fulfillment, dropshipping and warehousing solutions for perfume brands]

#### Fulfillment Services

From order processing to delivery, our fulfillment services are designed to offer complete logistics
support for niche, artisanal and perfume houses and beauty brands. We manage warehousing, packaging,
and shipping with attention to detail, ensuring that every product arrives in perfect condition to
your final customers. Our commitment to efficiency and excellence guarantees a smooth and reliable
experience for end clients.

#### DPLG, rooted in family tradition, bridges Paris, new york and Miami, innovating fragrances and
#### beauty solutions. We empower brands to diversify, expand, and uphold their legacy through
#### strategic licensing.

## WHAT WE DO

### fragrance and cosmetics Licensing

We build and develop fragrances, cosmetics, home scents and other beauty products for your brand via
our licensing arm, Perfume Street, Inc.

[ Learn more ][28]

### Brands

We build and scale our own cosmetic brands.

[ Learn more ][29]

### Fragrance Distribution

We distribute fragrances all over the world, notably in the U.S. and LATAM, in retail, wholesale and
DTC.

[ Learn more ][30]

a full suite of aluminum, window, and door products—backed by industry expertise, reliable service,

  We are based in Fort Lauderdale and serve clients across the state of Florida and export to the

## Frequently Asked Questions
* #### What does Florida Aluminum Products (FAP) do?
  
  FAP is a wholesale and logistics distribution company specializing in windows, doors, and aluminum
  products. We work with builders, contractors, and dealers to deliver products ranging from
  entry-level to luxury solutions across Florida.
* #### Who are your manufacturing partners?
  
  We proudly partner with industry-leading manufacturers such as ES Windows, CWS, CGI, and PGT,
  ensuring a wide range of products for every type of project.
* #### Do you only supply in Florida?
  
  We are based in Fort Lauderdale and serve clients across the state of Florida and export to the
  neighboring Islands.
* #### Do you sell directly to homeowners?
  
  No. FAP is a wholesale distributor. We work directly with contractors, builders, and dealers who
  serve homeowners and businesses.
* #### What makes FAP different from other distributors?
  
  Unlike many national distributors, FAP is Florida-based and Florida-focused. Our local presence
  means stronger service, faster logistics, and a commitment to reinvesting back into the state. 
* #### Do you offer engineering or project support?
  
  Yes. Our in-house team provides engineering and compliance support to help with specifications,
  submittals, and project planning.
* #### What regions of Florida do you cover?
  
  We cover the entire state of Florida, from the Panhandle to the Keys, with a strong presence in
  South Florida, Central Florida, and the Treasure Coast.
* #### How can I request a quote?
  
  You can request a quote by contacting our sales team directly through the website or by phone.
  Please provide project details so we can give you the most accurate pricing.
* #### What’s your typical lead time on orders?
  
  Lead times vary depending on the product and manufacturer. We’ll provide you with an estimated
  timeline when your order is placed, and we’ll keep you updated throughout the process.
* #### Do you provide installation services?
  
  No. FAP supplies products only. However, we can connect you with trusted contractors and
  installers through our network.

## Macchinari

**FAP progetta e realizza macchinari su misura per l’estrusione, la laminazione, il taglio e
l’avvolgimento di materiali espansi, film a bolle d’aria e un’ampia gamma di materiali termoplastici
— offrendo soluzioni complete per la produzione e la trasformazione della plastica.**

Ogni soluzione viene sviluppata insieme al cliente, unendo competenza tecnica e flessibilità per
rispondere a specifiche esigenze di prestazioni e di processo.

[complete foam extruder for production of foam tubes and profiles]

### Linee di estrusione per schiuma espansa

FAP progetta e produce linee di estrusione monovite e bivite contro-rotanti ad alte prestazioni,
ideali per la produzione continua di schiuma espansa 24 ore su 24  [**[...]**][67]

### Avvolgitori Automatici 

La nostra gamma di soluzioni è il risultato di oltre 38 anni di attività nella produzione di
avvolgitori per la schiuma espansa e a bolla d’aria [**[...]**][68]

[FOAM PLANK LAMINATING LINE]

### Linee di laminazione

FAP progetta e realizza linee di laminazione personalizzate su misura, costruite a progetto per la
lavorazione di materiali plastici[**[...]**][69]

### Macchine di converting

Le taglierine e le saldatrici FAP sono ideali per la lavorazione di piccoli e grandi lotti di
materiale plastico [**[...]**][70]

## Customer care

FAP vanta oltre 38 anni di esperienza e professionalità nel settore del film espanso. Siamo in grado
di offrire un progetto completo **“chiavi in mano”** partendo dalla: progettazione, realizzazione e
messa in produzione di una ampia gamma di macchinari.

### Parti di ricambio

Siamo in grado di gestire le richieste dei Clienti **in tempo reale**. Il magazzino attrezzato e
l’officina interna ci permettono di **ridurre i tempi di attesa** per la spedizione di un ricambio.

[

Richiedile ora

][71]

### Assistenza vendita

L’ufficio commerciale FAP analizza le richieste provenienti dai Clienti, offre la **miglior
soluzione** e garantisce il **miglior risultato** in termini di costi e produttività.

Supportiamo inoltre il Cliente in tutte le fasi decisionali fino all’avvio del progetto.

[

Richiedila ora

][72]

### Messa in produzione

Personale altamente qualificato installa i nostri impianti presso i Clienti, garantendo **alti
standard qualitativi e di sicurezza**.

Consideriamo il nostro lavoro terminato quando il Cliente è **soddisfatto del risultato finale**.

## Perchè scegliere FAP

#### Curiamo ogni particolare dalla progettazione alla costruzione dei nostri impianti, uniamo la
#### passione per le cose fatte bene alle migliori tecnologie esistenti. Questa è FAP: passione e
#### competenza.

[made-in-italy]

### 100%
### In-Home

I nostri tecnici progettano le macchine e nelle nostre officine tutto prende vita.

100% FAP, 100% made in Italy.

[Risparmio-energetico]

### Risparmio
### energetico

Vogliamo contribuire a costruire un Mondo migliore per le generazioni che verranno. Progettiamo
impianti ad alta efficienza, usando le migliori tecnologie a basso impatto ambientale.

[tecnologia-e-innovazione]

### Tecnologie innovative e all'avanguardia

Offriamo ai nostri Clienti le migliori soluzioni esistenti sul mercato, con un continuo impegno
nella ricerca di nuove tecnologie, per aggiornare e arricchire le funzionalità degli impianti.

# **CRÉATION DE PARFUM**

## Nous créons et fabriquons des parfums pour tous les secteurs d’application.

# QUI EST **FRAGRANCE CONTACT ?**

### Fragrance Contact est une société de création de parfum (et de fabrication) pour tout type
### d’application, basée en Région Parisienne.

### Alain Verjus, Parfumeur ayant plus de 40 ans d’expérience, décide en 2004 de créer Fragrance
### Contact pour proposer ses services personnalisés et “made in France” à des sociétés de toutes
### tailles. Souhaitant créer une société à taille humaine, sans pour autant négliger les exigences
### des clients de ce secteur, il forme une équipe expérimentée de collaborateurs et de partenaires,
### tous issus des grandes maisons de compositions et des principaux acteurs du marché de la
### parfumerie.

### Aujourd’hui la force de Fragrance Contact est cette expertise et cette flexibilité à tous les
### niveaux qui nous permettent de répondre rapidement et de manière compétente à vos demandes. Ce
### sont aussi les valeurs que nous défendons depuis le début: qualité du travail, qualité de nos
### produits, honnêteté avec nos fournisseurs, nos partenaires et nos clients.

### Rencontrons-nous! l’équipe de Fragrance Contact est à votre écoute pour vous accompagner dans la
### création de parfum conforme à vos besoins.

[Création de parfum - flacon]

# QUELS SERVICES NOUS PROPOSONS ?

## Découvrez nos services et expertises à votre disposition pour vous accompagner au mieux dans le
## développement de votre projet.
* **Analyse et études des tendances**
  Nous assurons une « veille » (newsletter, abonnement presse, blogs, conférences) afin d’identifier
  les nouvelles matières premières et d’ajuster nos propositions aux tendances du marché.
* **Etude de votre démande et cahier des charges**
  Nous formulons en adéquation avec votre brief marketing et vous proposons les meilleures
  directions olfactives.
* **Contrôle qualité**
  Notre laboratoire d’application vérifie la stabilité de l’odeur et de la couleur en application.
* **Envoi de propositions**
  Nous vous faisons parvenir nos soumissions sous forme d’échantillons et les retravaillons afin de
  correspondre parfaitement à votre projet.
* **Fabrication du parfum**
  Nous fabriquons votre parfum au prix le plus juste et vous le fournissons ensuite via l’un de nos
  transporteurs spécialisés.
* **Réglementation et Législation**
  Mise à disposition des documents techniques (FDS, FT, LA) et maîtrise des diverses réglementations
  internationales : IFRA, Règlement Cosmétique, REACH.

# QUELS SONT NOS ENGAGEMENTS ?

## CRÉATIVITÉ

Déjà plus de 3000 créations développées ! Nous étudions chaque brief et développons des compositions
spécifiques à chaque projet. Notre ambition: Vous enthousiasmer par nos soumissions!

## QUALITÉ

Déjà plus de 500 tonnes de compositions fabriquées ! Nous assurons des contrôles olfactif et
technique à chaque étape de la production et respectons les normes nationales et internationales de
transport.

## SAVOIR-FAIRE

Des compétences à chaque étape de votre projet ! Toute l’équipe bénéficie d’une grande expérience
dans la parfumerie et est à votre écoute pour vous fournir le meilleur des services.

## RÉSEAU

Nous sommes déjà présents par l’intermédiaire de partenaires commerciaux en France, Espagne, Italie,
Angleterre, Japon, Thailande, Vietnam et Moyen Orient, pour un suivi local de vos projets.

### ” BONJOUR,
### Être né à Grasse et y avoir passé mon enfance ne m’a pas « prédisposé » au metier de parfumeur,
### mais m’a énormément sensibilisé aux odeurs et à la parfumerie en général. J’ai ainsi
### naturellement commencé très jeune ma formation chez Robertet avant de me lancer dans une
### carrière internationale. Tout aussi logiquement, j’ai décidé de créer ma propre société, pour
### conserver une liberté dans la création du parfum mais aussi pour ajouter une dimension humaine à
### mon activité, avec une équipe et des partenaires fidèles.
### Mon métier est ma passion, j’ai la chance de pouvoir l’exercer tous les jours, avec des
### partenaires, tous amis, sur des projets fascinants. Merci! “

## founder's journey

*“Work hard, stay honest, and build something that lasts.” *— *Poland Moosa Haji, Founder and
Chairman of Fragrance World*

Arriving in the UAE in 1977, he began with an unwavering sense of purpose. Drawn to the art of
trade, he built his name in Deira’s bustling markets, guided by integrity, perseverance, and a gift
for understanding people. His early travels across Eastern Europe in the late 1980s marked the start
of his global outlook, earning him the affectionate name “Poland Moosa Haji.”

In 2004, his passion found its true expression with the creation of **Fragrance World**, a brand
born from craftsmanship, quality, and the belief that luxury should be accessible to all. What began
as a trading venture soon evolved into an international enterprise, exporting to more than **150+
countries** and producing over **75 million units annually.**

Today, under the leadership of his two sons as Co-CEOs, the Fragrance World legacy continues to
grow, rooted in the same values of authenticity, innovation, and timeless elegance that have defined
it from the very beginning.

#### Vision

To democratize the world of fragrance by making the art of perfumery accessible to everyone,
everywhere.

#### mission

To craft exceptional scents that rival the finest niche creations, using globally sourced
ingredients and meticulous craftsmanship, offered at accessible price points that redefine everyday
luxury.

#### values

Our values are rooted in innovation, excellence, ethics, and versatility, guiding every creation and
decision at Fragrance World.

## founder's journey

*“Work hard, stay honest, and build something that lasts.” *— *Poland Moosa Haji, Founder and
Chairman of Fragrance World*

Arriving in the UAE in 1977, he began with an unwavering sense of purpose. Drawn to the art of
trade, he built his name in Deira’s bustling markets, guided by integrity, perseverance, and a gift
for understanding people. His early travels across Eastern Europe in the late 1980s marked the start
of his global outlook, earning him the affectionate name “Poland Moosa Haji.”

In 2004, his passion found its true expression with the creation of **Fragrance World**, a brand
born from craftsmanship, quality, and the belief that luxury should be accessible to all. What began
as a trading venture soon evolved into an international enterprise, exporting to more than **150+
countries** and producing over **75 million units annually.**

Today, under the leadership of his two sons as Co-CEOs, the Fragrance World legacy continues to
grow, rooted in the same values of authenticity, innovation, and timeless elegance that have defined
it from the very beginning.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with

## [Leveraging Digital Technologies for Quality Financial Reporting in Ghana’s Public Sector: Does
## Leadership Style Matter?][37]

Page 1-29

[https://doi.org/10.33844/ijol.2026.60542][38]

Eyram Adzo Nyamuame, Jerome Cudjoe Katsekpor, Mensah Marfo, Edward Annan

**Abstract ** The improvement in transparency, efficiency, and accountability in public sector
financial management increasingly relies on advanced digital technologies. This paper explores the
individual and collective implications of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Computing (CC), and
Digital Payment Systems (DPS) on the quality of financial reporting in Ghana's public sector. It
investigates the moderating role of leadership styles in these relationships, which has not been
studied previously. Based on the Diffusion of Innovations Theory and the Institutional Theory, a
quantitative survey was conducted with 344 accountants and finance officers from various ministries,
departments, and agencies. The proposed relationships were tested using Structural Equation Modeling
(SEM). Results show that AI, CC, and DPS significantly improve financial reporting quality; when
used together, they have the most significant impact, highlighting the synergy of technological
integration. One key contribution of this study is to empirically confirm that leadership
styles—transformational, transactional, and participative—enhance the role of technological adoption
in improving reporting quality, whereas autocratic leadership does not. This underscores the
importance of leadership in digital accounting reforms and addresses a research gap, as leadership
is a critical yet underexplored factor influencing financial reporting quality in developing
economies. Theoretically, the study extends understanding of innovation diffusion models to public
sector accounting and demonstrates how institutional pressures influence digital technology
adoption. Practically, it emphasizes the need for leadership strategies to align with digital
initiatives and institutional processes to enhance reporting quality.

## [How Organizational Identification is Formed: Organizational Signals and Managerial Ethics][42]

Page 30-50

[https://doi.org/10.33844/ijol.2026.60543][43]

Altantsetseg Battulga, Altantuya B Ganbold

**Abstract ** Organizational Identification (OI) plays a central role in shaping employees’
attitudes, behaviors, and attachment to organizations. While prior research has extensively examined
the consequences of organizational identification, considerably less attention has been devoted to
understanding how identification itself is formed. Addressing this theoretical imbalance, the
present study conceptualizes organizational identification as a focal outcome shaped by
credibility-based organizational and supervisory cues. Drawing on social identity theory, we develop
and test an integrative multilevel model that examines the joint effects of organizational-level
legitimacy signals—corporate reputation and corporate social responsibility—and supervisor-level
relational mechanisms—ethical leadership and perceived supervisor support—on organizational
identification. Survey data were collected from employees working in privately owned organizations
in Mongolia, a post-socialist and transitional economy characterized by institutional change and
evolving managerial norms. Regression analyses indicate that ethical leadership, perceived
supervisor support, corporate reputation, and corporate social responsibility each exert significant
positive effects on organizational identification. Importantly, the findings demonstrate that
organizational-level and supervisor-level antecedents operate in combination rather than isolation,
underscoring the multilevel and credibility-driven nature of identification formation. By
positioning organizational identification as a focal outcome rather than merely a mediating
mechanism, this study advances organizational identification theory and extends social identity
theory to an underexplored institutional context. The findings further highlight the strategic
importance of ethical leadership, relational trust, and organizational legitimacy for fostering
durable employee attachment in emerging and transitional economies.

## Who We Are

Jhony USA is a global fragrance wholesaler, distributor, and exporter specializing in premium and
niche perfume brands. With over a decade of industry leadership, we are recognized for our extensive
and curated assortment, deep inventory, efficient fulfillment capabilities, and consistently
exceptional relationships with customers.

Serving partners across the United States and international markets, Jhony USA is committed to
delivering excellence at every level. We value long-term relationships and treat each client as a
strategic partner, offering dependable pricing, seamless logistics, and a service philosophy built
on trust, integrity, and attention to detail

[Jhony USA Team and Founders - Who We Are Section]
[Jhony USA luxury fragrance warehouse and distribution center]

## What we offer

At **Jhony USA**, we partner closely with our brand owners to deliver comprehensive distribution
across both brick-and-mortar retail and leading e-commerce platforms. Through our extensive
nationwide network, we strategically position each brand for maximum visibility and growth.

We support our partners with tailored in-store and digital marketing initiatives, utilizing premium
promotional materials and targeted marketing tools to elevate brand presence, expand market reach,
and foster lasting consumer loyalty

#### Our Mission

To connect the world’s finest perfume houses with U.S. retailers and distributors by delivering
authentic, high-quality fragrances through trusted partnerships, reliable logistics, and innovative
market strategies. J Perfumes aims to be a bridge between European elegance, Middle Eastern luxury,
and American retail excellence ensuring that every scent tells a story of craftsmanship and trust.

#### Our Vision

To become the leading fragrance distributor in the United States, recognized for authenticity,
exclusivity, and excellence in B2B partnerships — representing world-class perfume brands and
expanding their reach to every major market across North America.

## Who We Are

Jhony USA is a global fragrance wholesaler, distributor, and exporter specializing in premium and
niche perfume brands. With over a decade of industry leadership, we are recognized for our extensive
and curated assortment, deep inventory, efficient fulfillment capabilities, and consistently
exceptional relationships with customers.

Serving partners across the United States and international markets, Jhony USA is committed to
delivering excellence at every level. We value long-term relationships and treat each client as a
strategic partner, offering dependable pricing, seamless logistics, and a service philosophy built
on trust, integrity, and attention to detail

[Jhony USA Team and Founders - Who We Are Section]
[Jhony USA luxury fragrance warehouse and distribution center]

## What we offer

At **Jhony USA**, we partner closely with our brand owners to deliver comprehensive distribution
across both brick-and-mortar retail and leading e-commerce platforms. Through our extensive
nationwide network, we strategically position each brand for maximum visibility and growth.

We support our partners with tailored in-store and digital marketing initiatives, utilizing premium
promotional materials and targeted marketing tools to elevate brand presence, expand market reach,
and foster lasting consumer loyalty

#### Our Mission

To connect the world’s finest perfume houses with U.S. retailers and distributors by delivering
authentic, high-quality fragrances through trusted partnerships, reliable logistics, and innovative
market strategies. J Perfumes aims to be a bridge between European elegance, Middle Eastern luxury,
and American retail excellence ensuring that every scent tells a story of craftsmanship and trust.

#### Our Vision

To become the leading fragrance distributor in the United States, recognized for authenticity,
exclusivity, and excellence in B2B partnerships — representing world-class perfume brands and
expanding their reach to every major market across North America.

## Distributor of Prestige Fragrances and Cosmetics

For over 25 years, we've proudly served as the leading wholesale distributor in the USA,
specializing in top-tier fragrances, skin care, cosmetics, and gift sets. We handpick and supply
products from the most esteemed manufacturers, ensuring you receive only the finest selections. With
our deep-rooted reputation for reliability and excellence, you can always count on us to elevate
your beauty and fragrance offerings.

[Contact Us][10]

# Reasons to Buy from MB Fragrances

The MB Promise: Six Reasons Why We Stand Out

**Extensive Range of Products:** Dive into our diverse selection of perfumes, cosmetics, and
skincare products, curated to suit every taste and preference.
**Competitive Wholesale Pricing: **With us, you'll always get the best value. Our strong ties with
top manufacturers and bulk purchasing power allow us to provide products at unbeatable wholesale
prices.
**Fast & Reliable Shipping: **Our state-of-the-art logistics ensures that your orders are processed
swiftly and delivered on time. Whether it's a bulk order or a single item, we prioritize getting it
to you promptly.
**Tailored Solutions for Retailers: **Whether you're a small boutique or a large retailer, we can
cater to your specific needs. Our team is adept at customizing orders to match your inventory
demands.
**Exclusive Deals & Offers:** Loyal customers enjoy a plethora of exclusive deals, offers, and
discounts. Stay with us and discover unbeatable savings!
**Automated Documentation Process:** Navigating international trade can be complex, but with us,
it's seamless. Our advanced system automates the generation of essential documents, from export
invoices to packing slips and bills of lading. This ensures accurate, timely, and hassle-free
transactions, allowing you to focus on what you do best.
[Contact Us][11]

With access to thousands of fragrance brands, our selection distinctively highlights the world's
most esteemed names. From niche to mainstream, our extensive inventory ensures we can meet all your
business needs.

Paris Perfumes Inc. is a leader in distributing Niche & Premium brands in North America. We
specialize in exclusive and official distribution for high end and affordable fragrances. We
emphasize on our product’s unique qualities and benefits, along with the story behind each fragrance
in order to help our customers fully appreciate the brands we select.

Read more

We work hand in hand with our suppliers to provide full distribution of their brands, in brick &
mortar stores as well as the online market through a wide distribution network around the country.
We develop in-store and online marketing campaigns using promotional materials and marketing tools
to expand the brands’ reach and a strong loyalty to the end consumers

## Common Questions

### How to make an order at Perfume Plus Distributors?

Follow these steps to place an order at us:
* Register by completing the Application
* Once completed, our sales representative will contact you through email/WhatsApp
* Our representative will share wholesale catalogs and guide you thoroughly on order placement
* Once we receive your order and payment, our team starts packing your order

### Payment Method

We currently accept **ACH and Wire Transfer payments only**. Orders will be processed upon payment
confirmation.

**Note: At the moment, we are not offering payments via credit card**

### Are shipping charges included in the prices?

No, shipping cost is charged separately as per the recipient's location

### What is the minimum order amount?

The minimum order requirement is 2 pieces with a minimum order value of $1,500.

### Can I Drop-ship your products?

At the moment we are not offering drop shipping services.

### How long does it take to ship the order?

We ship your order within 24 hours after receiving payment.

### Do you ship to Latin America?

Yes, We have many long-term customers all over Latin America. For safe and secure
shipping, we encourage each client to communicate with the shipment company and
arrange the pickup from our warehouse.

### How often is the Wholesale Price List updated?

The List is updated **once a day.**

### Do you speak Spanish?

Yes. We speak Spanish, Portuguese, French and English

## Built for *serious* wholesale buyers.

Resellers, e-shops, drugstores and beauty chains across the EU work with us because the numbers add
up — and the stock is real.

### 100% authentic, fully traceable

Every product is sourced directly from manufacturers and authorized partners. **EU and non-EU stock
is clearly labeled in your account**, so you always know exactly what you're buying — with
documentation we can stand behind.

### Official oriental distributor

Authorized EU distributor for **Lattafa, Armaf, Afnan, Swiss Arabian, Ajmal, Khadlaj, Paris Corner**
and more — direct contracts, full licensing, GPSR-compliant. [See the full list →][13]

### Real stock, ready today

€24M permanently in our 3,500 m² warehouse. What you see online is what's on the shelf — same-day
dispatch on weekdays.

### EU-wide logistics

DHL, GLS and DPD shipping with transparent [pre-published rates][14] — no hidden fees, no surprises
at checkout.

### API & Quickshop

Plug us into your store via [REST API][15] or paste SKUs straight into [Quickshop][16] for instant
orders.

### Flexible payment terms

Bank transfer and card from day one. Pre-arranged payment terms are available after several
completed orders, business verification and credit insurance. Details on the [Payment page][17].

### Volume-based discounts

The more you order, the better the pricing. We offer **additional discounts based on order volume
and frequency**, negotiated case by case for our regular partners.

### Newsletter — news & promo stock

Stay ahead with our B2B newsletter: **new arrivals, restocks, promotional pricing and clearance
deals** straight to your inbox. Subscribed inside your account.

### Account team that picks up

Real people, real phone. Czech B2B operator with hundreds of verified resellers — see [our
clients][18].

# Luxury Wholesale Perfume Supplier & Distributor in Europe – RNEY Distribution B.V.

RNEY Distribution B.V. is a trusted wholesale perfume supplier in Europe, specializing in premium
fragrances from Dubai. We partner with perfume retailers, beauty chains and distributors to deliver
authentic, long-lasting scents at competitive wholesale prices. Our curated collection blends the
rich heritage of Arabic perfumery with the modern elegance European customers demand. Whether you
are a B2B fragrance buyer, reseller, or retailer, RNEY is your reliable partner for luxury perfumes
at wholesale rates, always ensuring high quality, authenticity, and profitable partnerships.

## Legacy in Every Bottle – Explore Our Iconic Perfume Brands

As a leading wholesale perfume supplier and distributor in Europe, RNEY Distribution proudly offers
a curated portfolio of authentic luxury, niche, and popular perfume brands. We specialise in the
wholesale of Oriental perfumes and high-end designer fragrances, featuring everything from deep,
expressive scents, to fresh, modern blends that appeal to every market. Partnering with RNEY
Distribution gives you access to competitive wholesale perfume prices, fast EU-wide reliable
shipping, and a diverse range of men’s and women’s fragrances. Whether you’re looking to stock
timeless classics or the latest perfume launches, our authentic products deliver quality, elegance,
style, and profitability for your business.

[ [Lattafa brand logo] ][27]

### Featured Brand

## Lattafa: A Symphony of Scents

Experience the enchanting fragrances of Lattafa, known for their exquisite blends that capture the
spirit of the Middle East. Each scent tells a story, offering a unique olfactory journey that
resonates with elegance and tradition. Lattafa was established in the UAE with a vision to celebrate
the rich heritage of Arabic perfumery while embracing modern fragrance trends. Since its inception,
Lattafa has made significant strides, quickly becoming one of the most recognized names in the
fragrance industry. The brand has successfully expanded its reach beyond the Middle East into
Europe, Asia, and Africa, thanks to its commitment to quality and artistry. Notable milestones
include the launch of best-selling collections that have garnered both critical and consumer
acclaim. Signature products like Ameer Al Oudh, known for its deep, woody notes, and Oud Mood, which
offers a sophisticated blend of spices and florals, have made Lattafa a favorite among retailers and
perfume enthusiasts alike.

# Leading Perfume Manufacturer in India

## Best Attar Manufacturer in India

## Your Partner in FRAGRANCES and PERFUME Manufacturing

SFP Sons India Pvt Ltd is a leading fragrance and perfume manufacturer, offering bespoke solutions
for global brands. With over 5000 unique fragrance profiles and a commitment to quality, we
specialize in OEM and private label manufacturing. Our state-of-the-art facilities and certified
processes ensure the highest standards in every product. We are your go-to partner for crafting
exquisite, long-lasting fragrances that captivate the senses worldwide.

### FRAGRANCES

A Legacy of Excellence and Innovation

At SFP Sons India Pvt Ltd, fragrance is not just our business; it’s our passion. Our journey began
with the exquisite and captivating Indian Jasmine, which first captivated the world’s senses, making
its way from India to France. This was the humble beginning of a long-standing legacy in the
fragrance industry. Our very first product, Ahsan Attarful, became a worldwide sensation,
establishing itself as one of the finest Jasmine fragrances globally. This iconic scent continues to
leave a lasting impression on fragrance enthusiasts and collectors alike

[Custom Fragrance Development - SFP Sons India]

### EXPORTS

Global Excellence in Perfumery – Exporting Luxury Worldwide

SFP Sons (India) Pvt Ltd stands proudly as the largest exporter of attars and traditional Indian
perfumes globally. With over four decades of expertise in the intricate art of perfumery, we have
built an unmatched reputation for quality and craftsmanship. Our fragrances, sourced from the finest
natural ingredients, blend timeless traditions with modern techniques to create scents that
transcend borders. Operating with a strong presence in international markets, we export our products
to over 50 countries, reaching regions across the Middle East, Europe, the Americas, and Asia. Each
fragrance is carefully curated to meet the varied preferences of global consumers, while still
maintaining the essence of Indian culture.

[Global Perfume Exports - SFP Sons India]

# CERTIFICATION

At SFP Sons, we prioritize quality, safety, and compliance in every step of the manufacturing
process. Our state-of-the-art production facilities are fully FDA-compliant, ensuring the highest
standards of safety and quality for our fragrances. We are also ISO certified, a testament to our
commitment to excellence in every aspect of our operations, from product development to final
delivery.

In addation, we adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), guaranteeing that every product is
made under stringent quality control protocols. Our MSME ZED Gold certification reflects our
dedication to maintaining superior quality while supporting India’s growth as a global manufacturing
hub.

# Made in India


As a Made In India brand, we take immense pride in our rich heritage and craftsmanship. Our products
embody the spirit of Indian tradition, innovation, and expertise, catering to global markets with
premium perfumes and attars that reflect a perfect blend of artistry and precision. Whether you are
a leading global brand looking for reliable manufacturing partners or a startup aiming to launch
your fragrance line, SFP Sons offers end-to-end solutions that meet international standards. From
fragrance creation to packaging, we ensure each product resonates with quality, elegance, and
sophistication.

## About Unico Pharmaceuticals

We specialize in developing natural, high-quality wellness products by combining traditional
Ayurvedic practices with advanced modern technology. Our expertise in **Ayurvedic Third Party
Manufacturing** and [**cosmetic products manufacturing**][48] enables us to deliver safe, effective,
and market-ready solutions. With comprehensive **private label manufacturing** and **Cosmetic
Manufacturing Services**, we support brands across India in building scalable and successful product
lines.

At **Unico Pharmaceuticals**, we create high-quality Ayurvedic and cosmetic products using the
perfect blend of traditional Ayurvedic knowledge and modern manufacturing technology. Our goal is to
help brands deliver safe, effective, and market-ready products that customers trust.

We specialize in **Ayurvedic third-party manufacturing**, **cosmetic manufacturing**, and **private
label manufacturing**. Whether you’re launching a new brand or expanding an existing one, we provide
complete manufacturing solutions tailored to your business needs.

With over [**35 years of industry experience**][49], we have built a strong reputation for quality,
consistency, and innovation. Our advanced manufacturing facility in Ludhiana, Punjab, follows strict
quality standards to ensure every product meets customer expectations.

Our product range includes skincare, haircare, personal care, herbal wellness products, and solid
perfumes. From product formulation and manufacturing to packaging and branding, we offer end-to-end
support under one roof.

At Unico Pharmaceuticals, we believe in building long-term partnerships by providing reliable
service, customized formulations, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions. Whether you are a
startup or an established company, our experienced team is here to help turn your ideas into
successful products.

**Partner with Unico Pharmaceuticals and grow your brand with trusted Ayurvedic and cosmetic
manufacturing solutions.**

Are the perfumes on V Perfumes original?

Yes. V Perfumes only sells original perfume and fragrances, the same stock we sell in our physical
stores. We have sold authentic perfumes since 2010 and do not deal in imitations, refills or
unbranded copies. What you order online is the real bottle.

 

Which countries does V Perfumes deliver to?

V Perfumes operates in four GCC markets, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman and Qatar,
each with its own store, website and local delivery. Your order is fulfilled from within your own
country, with local pricing and currency. Choose your country on this page to see its catalogue and

How long does delivery take?

Delivery time depends on your country and city and is shown at checkout. Because each market is
served locally, delivery is quick within your own country.

 

Does V Perfumes have physical stores?

Yes. V Perfumes runs more than 53 stores across the GCC, with branches in the UAE, Saudi Arabia,
Oman and Qatar, so you can shop in person as well as online in each market.

###### Wei Teh Flavour & Fragrance biotechnology corp

## A Leading Taiwanese Enterprise in Flavor & Fragrance R&D for A Half Century

Flavor and fragrance embody the most beautiful realm of realization and ideal in humans’ sense of
taste, and the flavorists’ creation for the ultimate significance can truly express the most
original, exquisite aroma of foods and desire in the world.

Founded in 1972, Wei Teh’s founder further delves into each aroma of foods to develop distinctive
acuity little by little. For nearly half a century, Wei Teh through the ISO and halal certification
has held firm to its corporate culture of “sincerity, professionalism, constant excellence.” 

Company introduction

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ds6msUIjjKI][24]

[Read More][25]

> 
> Wei Teh’s top-notch flavorists of the half-century R&D team have designed various taste
> experiences by looking at all possibilities of abundant flavors for foods that enhances the
> superior flavors of your foods and add the key aroma to them based on the liquid, powder, paste
> and microcapsule in diverse types.
> 
> Our R&D team also accurately looks at the aroma in different levels arising from the same
> ingredient but in different varieties and cooking methods to interpret the expression of exquisite
> sense of taste.
> 
>  
> 
> [More Flavors][26]

> # Fragrances
> 
> The existence of pleasant smell nourishes people’s features of life every moment and even relax
> and ease their bustling senses every day. Having extracted the nature breath of seasons, following
> a search for the fragrance from nature flowers, plants and woods or scents of beauty to create the
> ambient situation.
> 
> Wei Teh’s daily use chemical essence lab is creation sanctuary for artists of smell to explore
> thousands of ingredients for fragrance aesthetics that professionally creates ingredients of
> essences widely used in cosmetics and skin care products, shower and hand-wash products, spatial
> fragrance, top perfume to increase distinctive added value for products.
> 
>  
>

## NOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE

Reconnaitre l’importance de la responsabilité, du vivant, et de la durabilité, nous pousse à nous
transformer. Agir vite et bien. Pour accompagner nos clients acteurs du changement, Robertet façonne
le Naturel du futur.

[Futuring Naturals][61]

## ROBERTET X ASSOULINE

À l’occasion de son 175ᵉ anniversaire, Robertet dévoile un ouvrage d’exception édité par Assouline,
maison reconnue pour ses livres dédiés à l’art, au luxe et au patrimoine.

Disponible sur le site d’Assouline, ce livre retrace l’histoire singulière de Robertet, depuis ses
origines à Grasse jusqu’à son rayonnement international. À travers des archives inédites, des
témoignages et des images exclusives, il met en lumière l’héritage, le savoir-faire et la passion du
naturel qui animent le Groupe depuis 1850.

Plus qu’un livre anniversaire, cet ouvrage incarne l’ADN de Robertet : l’excellence, la créativité
et un engagement constant en faveur d’une innovation responsable, tournée vers l’avenir.

Véritable objet de collection, cette édition célèbre la transmission d’un savoir-faire unique et
rend hommage aux femmes et aux hommes qui font vivre la Maison depuis cinq générations.

[Découvrir][62]

## ROBERTET INVESTIT DANS AETHERA BIOTECH

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer l’investissement stratégique de Robertet dans Aethera Biotech, pionnier
européen des ingrédients cosmétiques actifs.

Cette étape marque notre entrée dans le domaine des biotechnologies végétales et renforce notre
stratégie « Augmented Naturality ». En combinant la technologie brevetée CROP® d’Aethera Biotech
avec l’expertise mondiale et la portée commerciale de Robertet Group, nous accélérerons l’innovation
dans les actifs cosmétiques et soutiendrons la croissance à long terme de notre division Health &
Beauty.

Une nouvelle étape pour réunir la nature et la science de pointe.

[Interview : Olivier Maubert][63]

## ECOVADIS : STATUT PLATINIUM

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que Robertet renforce son score EcoVadis.

Après avoir obtenu l’an dernier la médaille Platine avec un score de 83/100, Robertet a encore
progressé cette année en atteignant 88/100.

Cette distinction, attribuée aux entreprises figurant dans le Top 1 % mondial, reconnaît la qualité
et la solidité du système de management de la durabilité de notre Groupe. L’évaluation EcoVadis
repose sur quatre domaines clés : l’Environnement, le Social & Droits Humains, l’Éthique et les
Achats Responsables.

Cette progression illustre la détermination de Robertet à aller toujours plus loin dans l’alliance
entre performance et responsabilité.

Nous remercions l’ensemble de nos équipes pour leur engagement collectif et quotidien, et plus
particulièrement notre Directrice RSE, pour son dévouement constant dans cette réussite.

Malgré un contexte économique mondial incertain, ces résultats reflètent la solidité du modèle du
Groupe, porté par son expertise du naturel, son agilité et sa dynamique d’innovation.

confiance dans ses ambitions à l’horizon 2030.

## CLEAN R SCENT : Nouvelle génération d’absolues

CleanRscent est la nouvelle gamme d’absolues éco-conçues de Robertet, basée sur une technologie
brevetée, offrant une réponse immédiate aux demandes des clients et du marché pour une parfumerie
plus responsable. Ouvrant une voie d’avenir pour les absolues, ingrédients emblématiques de la
parfumerie, cleanRscent offre une haute performance olfactive avec un profil authentique « True to
Nature » et une signature unique pour des parfums éco-conçus, 100% sans résidus d’hexane.

Welcome to our wholesale perfume and cosmetics website. If you are looking for a reliable and high
quality perfume supplier, you have come to the right place. We have been in the perfume and
cosmetics import-export business for years, guaranteeing our customers a wide range of items from
the best brands, at competitive prices.

We specialize in perfume wholesaling, passionately dedicating ourselves to providing exclusive
products to both perfumeries and other retailers in the industry. As a perfume wholesaler, our
mission is to offer authentic, high-quality products and to help companies meet the needs of the
ever-changing market.

We collaborate with a global network of perfume and cosmetics manufacturers and distributors to
bring the best to the market. Through our perfume import-export services, we are able to provide
branded products from around the world, including exclusive perfumes, market novelties, and
evergreen products loved by consumers of all ages.


### What sets us apart among perfume and cosmetics wholesalers
1. [Wide range of products][9]: We offer a large and diverse selection of wholesale perfumes and

2. Quality and authenticity guaranteed: All products in our wholesale perfumery are guaranteed to be

   and cosmetics brands.
3. Competitive prices: As a perfume wholesaler, we know how important value for money is to our
   customers. Because of our business model, we are able to offer branded perfumes and cosmetics at
   very competitive wholesale prices, without ever compromising on quality.
4. Personalized customer service: Whether you are a small local perfumery or a large chain, we are
   committed to providing a tailored service. Every customer is important to us, and our team is
   always available to support you every step of the way.
5. Fast and safe shipping: Our logistics service allows us to handle both domestic and international
   orders quickly and efficiently. We ensure that your wholesale orders of perfumes and cosmetics

# Structured Industrial Access to Latin America for Global Manufacturers

Latin America is not a market to explore. It is a region that requires structure, qualified
representation, and a defined operational pathway. ConectNext functions as a strategic bridge
enabling industrial manufacturers and solution providers to establish a credible and effective
presence across the region.

ConectNext is not a traditional directory. It is an integrated expansion platform that combines
regional visibility, governed representation, and on-the-ground execution within a unified
operational ecosystem. We work with international companies seeking to enter and scale in Latin
America, enabling structured access to relevant decision-makers, distributors, industrial buyers,
and institutional counterparts across more than 23 strategic sectors, including Industrial
Machinery, AgriTech, Pharma, Energy, Logistics, and Advanced Materials.

Latin America encompasses a market of more than 670 million people and a combined GDP exceeding USD
6.4 trillion, representing one of the world’s most dynamic growth environments. However, successful
market entry requires far more than commercial intent. It demands local presence, regulatory
clarity, cultural alignment, and trusted operational frameworks.

Through ConectNext, organizations gain structured access to the region, supported by qualified
representation, sector-specific intelligence, and a vetted operational network. This approach
ensures that expansion into Latin America is strategic, scalable, and aligned with real commercial
opportunity — not speculation.

The platform’s full structural definition is outlined in [What Is ConectNext][19].

## Why ConectNext Is the Strategic Choice for Expansion into Latin America

ConectNext is built specifically for manufacturers, industrial technology providers, and B2B
solution firms that require a structured and reliable entry into Latin America. Expanding into the
region is not simply a commercial initiative — it is an operational decision that demands market
clarity, controlled risk, and local presence. ConectNext centralizes these capabilities within a
single, integrated expansion hub.

Our platform aligns market access, regional visibility, commercial representation, and operational
execution under one coordinated framework. This enables companies to evaluate, enter, and expand in
Latin America without opening a local office, committing to high upfront investment, or navigating
fragmented networks independently.

The ConectNext model bridges global strategy with local implementation. International intent is
translated into on-the-ground execution through governed structures. Whether the objective is to
validate demand, position a brand, establish distribution pathways, or develop long-term commercial
presence, ConectNext operates as a strategic business extension in [Colombia and across Latin
America.][20]

From sector intelligence and competitive benchmarking to trade fair participation, commercial
representation, negotiation support, and structured engagement aligned with defined mandates, we
ensure that expansion initiatives remain coordinated, professional, and grounded in real commercial
opportunity.

B2B Expansion Platform: [Scope And Participation Model][21] 

**ConectNext. We provide structure**

## Structured Industrial Visibility

ConectNext provides a governed visibility framework within defined industrial sectors. Exposure is
structured by industry relevance, operational scope, and decision context, ensuring that visibility
is contextual, deliberate, and aligned with how industrial decisions are actually made.

## Controlled Market Presence

Market presence is established through structured positioning, representation frameworks, and
defined responsibility boundaries. Engagement occurs under clear governance rules, preserving
professional distance, accountability, and continuity without requiring premature local deployment
or uncontrolled intermediaries.

## Decision-Grade Market Intelligence

ConectNext delivers sector-specific analysis, structural demand signals, and competitive context
designed to support informed decision-making. Intelligence is framed to reduce uncertainty, clarify
exposure, and support strategic judgment — not to replace it with assumptions or forecasts.

To learn how we build and validate our analytical outputs, review the* [ConectNext Research
Framework.][22]*

FEATURED BRANDS
* ## Kajal Perfumes Paris
  
  **Kajal Perfumes Paris **is a French niche fragrance house that draws inspiration from the Arabic
  word khajal – which means** being humble, modest and viewing others with dignity and respect**.
* ## Laboratorio Olfattivo
  
  A high-end perfumery project of artistic perfumery working with *Maîtres Parfumeurs* who create
  freely, without any limitations on their imagination. Noses include **Jean-Claude Elena**,
  **Cecile Zarokian** and **Dominic Ropion**.
* ## Filippo Sorcinelli
  
  **Filippo Sorcinelli **is a lifestyle brand, the result of a collaboration between the **arts**. A
  brand that is synonymous with **niche fragrances** and **daring concepts**.
* ## Nobile 1942
  
  **Nobile 1942 **carries on a rich family tradition of perfumery. Each bottle is **hand-crafted
  **and each scent is specially selected from the work of the **best perfumers** across the world.
* ## Scentologia
  
  **Scentologia **is a luxury fragrance brand founded in **Paris **and built on the idea that
  perfumery is a unique intersection of **art and science**, where the laboratory meets the canvas.

[ SEE ALL BRANDS ][23]

## OUR SERVICES

[Kajal Perfumes Display]

#### Brand Distribution & Activation

Our perfume distribution and activation services bring niche, artisanal and luxury fragrances to
discerning North American retailers. With a curated portfolio of exclusive perfume houses, we ensure
that each scent reaches high-end clients and boutiques with precision and care. Our industry
knowledge and relationships allow us to provide tailored solutions for every brand’s unique
distribution, marketing and educational needs.

[Fulfillment, dropshipping and warehousing solutions for perfume brands]

#### Fulfillment Services

From order processing to delivery, our fulfillment services are designed to offer complete logistics
support for niche, artisanal and perfume houses and beauty brands. We manage warehousing, packaging,
and shipping with attention to detail, ensuring that every product arrives in perfect condition to
your final customers. Our commitment to efficiency and excellence guarantees a smooth and reliable
experience for end clients.

#### DPLG, rooted in family tradition, bridges Paris, new york and Miami, innovating fragrances and
#### beauty solutions. We empower brands to diversify, expand, and uphold their legacy through
#### strategic licensing.

## WHAT WE DO

### fragrance and cosmetics Licensing

We build and develop fragrances, cosmetics, home scents and other beauty products for your brand via
our licensing arm, Perfume Street, Inc.

[ Learn more ][28]

### Brands

We build and scale our own cosmetic brands.

[ Learn more ][29]

### Fragrance Distribution

We distribute fragrances all over the world, notably in the U.S. and LATAM, in retail, wholesale and
DTC.

[ Learn more ][30]

#### After acting as the Chief Commercial Officer for the company Léonard on French and Japanese

world, with work history with Coty, Interparfum, L’Oréal, Clarins and others.

#### — Alexandre Cukier, Founder

each brand as if it were our own.**

execution to e-commerce, fulfillment, and brand development. Ensuring each maison is represented

## Art, research and poetry

[ RESEARCH & STYLE ][33]

Fap Designers take the time to handle and **play around with the material**, using original
craftsmanship practices and new materials to identify the effect and the emotion they wish to convey
to the ceramic tiles. This is a complex, thrilling artistic process, aimed at satisfying the desires
of architects, project designers and design lovers. This is the origin of **Fap's contemporary
craftsmanship approach**, the extra-large sizes, the new take on walls and how to decorate them,
exploring the hidden potential of the third dimension of ceramic tiles. The Fap collections are
inspired by** an intuition fed by art**, aesthetic research, colour and material. We observe the
evolution of the world around us o design interiors that resonate with you, that welcome you and
make you feel good.

## Fragrance Contact est une société de

# **CRÉATION DE PARFUM**

## Nous créons et fabriquons des parfums pour tous les secteurs d’application.

# QUI EST **FRAGRANCE CONTACT ?**

### Fragrance Contact est une société de création de parfum (et de fabrication) pour tout type
### d’application, basée en Région Parisienne.

### Alain Verjus, Parfumeur ayant plus de 40 ans d’expérience, décide en 2004 de créer Fragrance
### Contact pour proposer ses services personnalisés et “made in France” à des sociétés de toutes
### tailles. Souhaitant créer une société à taille humaine, sans pour autant négliger les exigences
### des clients de ce secteur, il forme une équipe expérimentée de collaborateurs et de partenaires,
### tous issus des grandes maisons de compositions et des principaux acteurs du marché de la
### parfumerie.

### Aujourd’hui la force de Fragrance Contact est cette expertise et cette flexibilité à tous les
### niveaux qui nous permettent de répondre rapidement et de manière compétente à vos demandes. Ce
### sont aussi les valeurs que nous défendons depuis le début: qualité du travail, qualité de nos
### produits, honnêteté avec nos fournisseurs, nos partenaires et nos clients.

### Rencontrons-nous! l’équipe de Fragrance Contact est à votre écoute pour vous accompagner dans la
### création de parfum conforme à vos besoins.

[Création de parfum - flacon]

# QUELS SERVICES NOUS PROPOSONS ?

## Découvrez nos services et expertises à votre disposition pour vous accompagner au mieux dans le
## développement de votre projet.
* **Analyse et études des tendances**
  Nous assurons une « veille » (newsletter, abonnement presse, blogs, conférences) afin d’identifier
  les nouvelles matières premières et d’ajuster nos propositions aux tendances du marché.
* **Etude de votre démande et cahier des charges**
  Nous formulons en adéquation avec votre brief marketing et vous proposons les meilleures
  directions olfactives.
* **Contrôle qualité**
  Notre laboratoire d’application vérifie la stabilité de l’odeur et de la couleur en application.
* **Envoi de propositions**
  Nous vous faisons parvenir nos soumissions sous forme d’échantillons et les retravaillons afin de
  correspondre parfaitement à votre projet.
* **Fabrication du parfum**
  Nous fabriquons votre parfum au prix le plus juste et vous le fournissons ensuite via l’un de nos
  transporteurs spécialisés.
* **Réglementation et Législation**
  Mise à disposition des documents techniques (FDS, FT, LA) et maîtrise des diverses réglementations
  internationales : IFRA, Règlement Cosmétique, REACH.

# QUELS SONT NOS ENGAGEMENTS ?

## CRÉATIVITÉ

Déjà plus de 3000 créations développées ! Nous étudions chaque brief et développons des compositions
spécifiques à chaque projet. Notre ambition: Vous enthousiasmer par nos soumissions!

## QUALITÉ

Déjà plus de 500 tonnes de compositions fabriquées ! Nous assurons des contrôles olfactif et
technique à chaque étape de la production et respectons les normes nationales et internationales de
transport.

## SAVOIR-FAIRE

Des compétences à chaque étape de votre projet ! Toute l’équipe bénéficie d’une grande expérience
dans la parfumerie et est à votre écoute pour vous fournir le meilleur des services.

## RÉSEAU

Nous sommes déjà présents par l’intermédiaire de partenaires commerciaux en France, Espagne, Italie,
Angleterre, Japon, Thailande, Vietnam et Moyen Orient, pour un suivi local de vos projets.
Contactez-nous !

## d’applications souhaités.

## Un parfum en France, un shampooing en Italie, un savon en Corée, un détergent en Tunisie, un
## parfum de niche en Espagne, un parfum d’ambiance au Japon, un désodorisant à l’île Maurice ou

* **Etude de votre démande et cahier des charges**
  Nous formulons en adéquation avec votre brief marketing et vous proposons les meilleures
  directions olfactives.
* **Contrôle qualité**
  Notre laboratoire d’application vérifie la stabilité de l’odeur et de la couleur en application.
* **Envoi de propositions**
  Nous vous faisons parvenir nos soumissions sous forme d’échantillons et les retravaillons afin de
  correspondre parfaitement à votre projet.
* **Fabrication du parfum**
  Nous fabriquons votre parfum au prix le plus juste et vous le fournissons ensuite via l’un de nos
  transporteurs spécialisés.
* **Réglementation et Législation**
  Mise à disposition des documents techniques (FDS, FT, LA) et maîtrise des diverses réglementations
  internationales : IFRA, Règlement Cosmétique, REACH.

## founder's journey

*“Work hard, stay honest, and build something that lasts.” *— *Poland Moosa Haji, Founder and
Chairman of Fragrance World*

Arriving in the UAE in 1977, he began with an unwavering sense of purpose. Drawn to the art of
trade, he built his name in Deira’s bustling markets, guided by integrity, perseverance, and a gift
for understanding people. His early travels across Eastern Europe in the late 1980s marked the start
of his global outlook, earning him the affectionate name “Poland Moosa Haji.”

In 2004, his passion found its true expression with the creation of **Fragrance World**, a brand
born from craftsmanship, quality, and the belief that luxury should be accessible to all. What began
as a trading venture soon evolved into an international enterprise, exporting to more than **150+
countries** and producing over **75 million units annually.**

Today, under the leadership of his two sons as Co-CEOs, the Fragrance World legacy continues to
grow, rooted in the same values of authenticity, innovation, and timeless elegance that have defined
it from the very beginning.

#### Vision

To democratize the world of fragrance by making the art of perfumery accessible to everyone,

#### mission

To craft exceptional scents that rival the finest niche creations, using globally sourced
ingredients and meticulous craftsmanship, offered at accessible price points that redefine everyday
luxury.

#### values

Our values are rooted in innovation, excellence, ethics, and versatility, guiding every creation and
decision at Fragrance World.
