## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source

  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business

## [Leveraging Digital Technologies for Quality Financial Reporting in Ghana’s Public Sector: Does
## Leadership Style Matter?][37]

Page 1-29

[https://doi.org/10.33844/ijol.2026.60542][38]

Eyram Adzo Nyamuame, Jerome Cudjoe Katsekpor, Mensah Marfo, Edward Annan

**Abstract ** The improvement in transparency, efficiency, and accountability in public sector
financial management increasingly relies on advanced digital technologies. This paper explores the
individual and collective implications of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Computing (CC), and
Digital Payment Systems (DPS) on the quality of financial reporting in Ghana's public sector. It
investigates the moderating role of leadership styles in these relationships, which has not been
studied previously. Based on the Diffusion of Innovations Theory and the Institutional Theory, a
quantitative survey was conducted with 344 accountants and finance officers from various ministries,
departments, and agencies. The proposed relationships were tested using Structural Equation Modeling
(SEM). Results show that AI, CC, and DPS significantly improve financial reporting quality; when
used together, they have the most significant impact, highlighting the synergy of technological
integration. One key contribution of this study is to empirically confirm that leadership
styles—transformational, transactional, and participative—enhance the role of technological adoption
in improving reporting quality, whereas autocratic leadership does not. This underscores the
importance of leadership in digital accounting reforms and addresses a research gap, as leadership
is a critical yet underexplored factor influencing financial reporting quality in developing
economies. Theoretically, the study extends understanding of innovation diffusion models to public
sector accounting and demonstrates how institutional pressures influence digital technology
adoption. Practically, it emphasizes the need for leadership strategies to align with digital
initiatives and institutional processes to enhance reporting quality.

## [How Organizational Identification is Formed: Organizational Signals and Managerial Ethics][42]

Page 30-50

[https://doi.org/10.33844/ijol.2026.60543][43]

Altantsetseg Battulga, Altantuya B Ganbold

**Abstract ** Organizational Identification (OI) plays a central role in shaping employees’
attitudes, behaviors, and attachment to organizations. While prior research has extensively examined
the consequences of organizational identification, considerably less attention has been devoted to
understanding how identification itself is formed. Addressing this theoretical imbalance, the
present study conceptualizes organizational identification as a focal outcome shaped by
credibility-based organizational and supervisory cues. Drawing on social identity theory, we develop
and test an integrative multilevel model that examines the joint effects of organizational-level
legitimacy signals—corporate reputation and corporate social responsibility—and supervisor-level
relational mechanisms—ethical leadership and perceived supervisor support—on organizational
identification. Survey data were collected from employees working in privately owned organizations
in Mongolia, a post-socialist and transitional economy characterized by institutional change and
evolving managerial norms. Regression analyses indicate that ethical leadership, perceived
supervisor support, corporate reputation, and corporate social responsibility each exert significant
positive effects on organizational identification. Importantly, the findings demonstrate that
organizational-level and supervisor-level antecedents operate in combination rather than isolation,
underscoring the multilevel and credibility-driven nature of identification formation. By
positioning organizational identification as a focal outcome rather than merely a mediating
mechanism, this study advances organizational identification theory and extends social identity
theory to an underexplored institutional context. The findings further highlight the strategic
importance of ethical leadership, relational trust, and organizational legitimacy for fostering
durable employee attachment in emerging and transitional economies.

## Who We Are

Jhony USA is a global fragrance wholesaler, distributor, and exporter specializing in premium and
niche perfume brands. With over a decade of industry leadership, we are recognized for our extensive
and curated assortment, deep inventory, efficient fulfillment capabilities, and consistently
exceptional relationships with customers.

Serving partners across the United States and international markets, Jhony USA is committed to
delivering excellence at every level. We value long-term relationships and treat each client as a
strategic partner, offering dependable pricing, seamless logistics, and a service philosophy built
on trust, integrity, and attention to detail

[Jhony USA Team and Founders - Who We Are Section]
[Jhony USA luxury fragrance warehouse and distribution center]

## What we offer

At **Jhony USA**, we partner closely with our brand owners to deliver comprehensive distribution
across both brick-and-mortar retail and leading e-commerce platforms. Through our extensive
nationwide network, we strategically position each brand for maximum visibility and growth.

We support our partners with tailored in-store and digital marketing initiatives, utilizing premium
promotional materials and targeted marketing tools to elevate brand presence, expand market reach,
and foster lasting consumer loyalty

#### Our Mission

To connect the world’s finest perfume houses with U.S. retailers and distributors by delivering
authentic, high-quality fragrances through trusted partnerships, reliable logistics, and innovative
market strategies. J Perfumes aims to be a bridge between European elegance, Middle Eastern luxury,
and American retail excellence ensuring that every scent tells a story of craftsmanship and trust.

#### Our Vision

To become the leading fragrance distributor in the United States, recognized for authenticity,
exclusivity, and excellence in B2B partnerships — representing world-class perfume brands and
expanding their reach to every major market across North America.

## Common Questions

### How to make an order at Perfume Plus Distributors?

Follow these steps to place an order at us:
* Register by completing the Application
* Once completed, our sales representative will contact you through email/WhatsApp
* Our representative will share wholesale catalogs and guide you thoroughly on order placement
* Once we receive your order and payment, our team starts packing your order

### Payment Method

We currently accept **ACH and Wire Transfer payments only**. Orders will be processed upon payment
confirmation.

**Note: At the moment, we are not offering payments via credit card**

### Are shipping charges included in the prices?

No, shipping cost is charged separately as per the recipient's location

### What is the minimum order amount?

The minimum order requirement is 2 pieces with a minimum order value of $1,500.

### Can I Drop-ship your products?

At the moment we are not offering drop shipping services.

### How long does it take to ship the order?

We ship your order within 24 hours after receiving payment.

### Do you ship to Latin America?

Yes, We have many long-term customers all over Latin America. For safe and secure
shipping, we encourage each client to communicate with the shipment company and
arrange the pickup from our warehouse.

### How often is the Wholesale Price List updated?

The List is updated **once a day.**

### Do you speak Spanish?

Yes. We speak Spanish, Portuguese, French and English

# Luxury Wholesale Perfume Supplier & Distributor in Europe – RNEY Distribution B.V.

RNEY Distribution B.V. is a trusted wholesale perfume supplier in Europe, specializing in premium
fragrances from Dubai. We partner with perfume retailers, beauty chains and distributors to deliver
authentic, long-lasting scents at competitive wholesale prices. Our curated collection blends the
rich heritage of Arabic perfumery with the modern elegance European customers demand. Whether you
are a B2B fragrance buyer, reseller, or retailer, RNEY is your reliable partner for luxury perfumes
at wholesale rates, always ensuring high quality, authenticity, and profitable partnerships.

## Legacy in Every Bottle – Explore Our Iconic Perfume Brands

As a leading wholesale perfume supplier and distributor in Europe, RNEY Distribution proudly offers
a curated portfolio of authentic luxury, niche, and popular perfume brands. We specialise in the
wholesale of Oriental perfumes and high-end designer fragrances, featuring everything from deep,
expressive scents, to fresh, modern blends that appeal to every market. Partnering with RNEY
Distribution gives you access to competitive wholesale perfume prices, fast EU-wide reliable
shipping, and a diverse range of men’s and women’s fragrances. Whether you’re looking to stock
timeless classics or the latest perfume launches, our authentic products deliver quality, elegance,
style, and profitability for your business.

offers a sophisticated blend of spices and florals, have made Lattafa a favorite among retailers and

# Leading Perfume Manufacturer in India

## Best Attar Manufacturer in India

## Your Partner in FRAGRANCES and PERFUME Manufacturing

SFP Sons India Pvt Ltd is a leading fragrance and perfume manufacturer, offering bespoke solutions
for global brands. With over 5000 unique fragrance profiles and a commitment to quality, we
specialize in OEM and private label manufacturing. Our state-of-the-art facilities and certified
processes ensure the highest standards in every product. We are your go-to partner for crafting
exquisite, long-lasting fragrances that captivate the senses worldwide.

### FRAGRANCES

A Legacy of Excellence and Innovation

At SFP Sons India Pvt Ltd, fragrance is not just our business; it’s our passion. Our journey began
with the exquisite and captivating Indian Jasmine, which first captivated the world’s senses, making
its way from India to France. This was the humble beginning of a long-standing legacy in the
fragrance industry. Our very first product, Ahsan Attarful, became a worldwide sensation,
establishing itself as one of the finest Jasmine fragrances globally. This iconic scent continues to
leave a lasting impression on fragrance enthusiasts and collectors alike

[Custom Fragrance Development - SFP Sons India]

### EXPORTS

Global Excellence in Perfumery – Exporting Luxury Worldwide

SFP Sons (India) Pvt Ltd stands proudly as the largest exporter of attars and traditional Indian
perfumes globally. With over four decades of expertise in the intricate art of perfumery, we have
built an unmatched reputation for quality and craftsmanship. Our fragrances, sourced from the finest
natural ingredients, blend timeless traditions with modern techniques to create scents that
transcend borders. Operating with a strong presence in international markets, we export our products
to over 50 countries, reaching regions across the Middle East, Europe, the Americas, and Asia. Each
fragrance is carefully curated to meet the varied preferences of global consumers, while still
maintaining the essence of Indian culture.

[Global Perfume Exports - SFP Sons India]

# CERTIFICATION

At SFP Sons, we prioritize quality, safety, and compliance in every step of the manufacturing
process. Our state-of-the-art production facilities are fully FDA-compliant, ensuring the highest
standards of safety and quality for our fragrances. We are also ISO certified, a testament to our
commitment to excellence in every aspect of our operations, from product development to final
delivery.

In addation, we adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), guaranteeing that every product is
made under stringent quality control protocols. Our MSME ZED Gold certification reflects our
dedication to maintaining superior quality while supporting India’s growth as a global manufacturing
hub.

# Made in India


As a Made In India brand, we take immense pride in our rich heritage and craftsmanship. Our products
embody the spirit of Indian tradition, innovation, and expertise, catering to global markets with
premium perfumes and attars that reflect a perfect blend of artistry and precision. Whether you are
a leading global brand looking for reliable manufacturing partners or a startup aiming to launch
your fragrance line, SFP Sons offers end-to-end solutions that meet international standards. From
fragrance creation to packaging, we ensure each product resonates with quality, elegance, and
sophistication.

About Us

### Founded in 1991, Total Freight International (TFI) is one of the leading logistics solutions
### providers in Dubai, UAE. 

[ know more ][121]

We started our journey as an international freight forwarder, specializing in land, sea, and air.
Yet, in just a short period of time, we have rapidly grown into one of the leading logistics
companies in Dubai offering a host of services under one roof, including dangerous goods (DG)
handling & transportation via air freight and pharmaceutical logistics.

Our state-of-the-art and digital-driven 3PL warehouse facilities, spanning 70,000 sq ft., are
strategically located in Dubai Logistics City. This enables us to cater to the needs of our local
and international clients within a single-bonded free zone environment.

## About Unico Pharmaceuticals

We specialize in developing natural, high-quality wellness products by combining traditional
Ayurvedic practices with advanced modern technology. Our expertise in **Ayurvedic Third Party
Manufacturing** and [**cosmetic products manufacturing**][48] enables us to deliver safe, effective,
and market-ready solutions. With comprehensive **private label manufacturing** and **Cosmetic
Manufacturing Services**, we support brands across India in building scalable and successful product
lines.

At **Unico Pharmaceuticals**, we create high-quality Ayurvedic and cosmetic products using the
perfect blend of traditional Ayurvedic knowledge and modern manufacturing technology. Our goal is to
help brands deliver safe, effective, and market-ready products that customers trust.

We specialize in **Ayurvedic third-party manufacturing**, **cosmetic manufacturing**, and **private
label manufacturing**. Whether you’re launching a new brand or expanding an existing one, we provide
complete manufacturing solutions tailored to your business needs.

With over [**35 years of industry experience**][49], we have built a strong reputation for quality,
consistency, and innovation. Our advanced manufacturing facility in Ludhiana, Punjab, follows strict
quality standards to ensure every product meets customer expectations.

Our product range includes skincare, haircare, personal care, herbal wellness products, and solid
perfumes. From product formulation and manufacturing to packaging and branding, we offer end-to-end
support under one roof.

At Unico Pharmaceuticals, we believe in building long-term partnerships by providing reliable
service, customized formulations, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions. Whether you are a
startup or an established company, our experienced team is here to help turn your ideas into
successful products.

**Partner with Unico Pharmaceuticals and grow your brand with trusted Ayurvedic and cosmetic
manufacturing solutions.**

###### Wei Teh Flavour & Fragrance biotechnology corp

## A Leading Taiwanese Enterprise in Flavor & Fragrance R&D for A Half Century

Flavor and fragrance embody the most beautiful realm of realization and ideal in humans’ sense of
taste, and the flavorists’ creation for the ultimate significance can truly express the most
original, exquisite aroma of foods and desire in the world.

Founded in 1972, Wei Teh’s founder further delves into each aroma of foods to develop distinctive
acuity little by little. For nearly half a century, Wei Teh through the ISO and halal certification
has held firm to its corporate culture of “sincerity, professionalism, constant excellence.”
